faq.description: Everything you need to know about Libo before you join.
faq.a1: Libo offers a free tier with access to workouts, exercises, basic tracking, common product giveaways, and entry-level cash challenges. Premium and Elite unlock the full library, advanced analytics, larger cash-challenge stakes, and Premium / Special prize giveaways.
faq.a2: None — or everything. Libo has 295 home exercises (most need no equipment), 313 gym exercises, and 33 mobility moves. Filter by what you have available.
faq.q3: How do the money challenges work?
faq.a3: Join a 30-day challenge (e.g., 50 pushups daily), record yourself completing the reps each day, share to your stories, and cash out real money when you finish. Limited spots per challenge.
faq.q4: Can I build my own workouts?
faq.a4: Yes. The Custom Builder lets you pick from 634 exercises, set your own sets, reps, and rest times, then save and reuse your workouts anytime.
faq.a5: Libo is iOS only at launch. Android support is on our roadmap — we'll announce a date when it's locked. For now, the App Store badge above will get you started on any iPhone.
faq.q6: How is Libo different from other fitness apps?
faq.a6: Libo combines a massive exercise library, structured programs, progress tracking, and real cash challenges in one app — with a premium dark UI that stays out of your way. No ads, no clutter.
faq.a7: Yes. Libo includes multi-week programs designed for specific goals — muscle building, fat loss, mobility, and more. Follow the plan, log your progress, and see real results.
faq.a8: Every set, rep, and weight is logged. Libo tracks your workout history, personal records, streaks, and shows your progress over time with clear charts.
faq.androidAnswerPrelaunch: Libo will launch on iOS first. Android support is on our roadmap — we'll announce a date once it's locked. Sign up for the waitlist above to be notified when iOS launches.

faq.q1: Is this giveaway open in my country?
faq.a1: Available globally except where prohibited by local law. The following jurisdictions are excluded from paid-entry promotions at launch: Quebec, Brazil, mainland China, and OFAC / EU / UN sanctioned regions. The free in-app entry path (download Libo + complete a workout to earn points) is open in every other jurisdiction. Minimum entry age varies by giveaway type — see Terms (Section 3).
faq.a2: No. Every pack is a single one-time payment. No subscription, no auto-renewal, no recurring charges. You buy it once, you get the points and access window, that's it.
faq.q3: Do I receive my points and access instantly?
faq.a3: Yes. The moment your payment confirms, your points are credited to your Libo account and your full-app access window starts. Convert points to giveaway tickets in-app whenever you want.
faq.q4: Do I get the iPhone or the cash?
faq.a4: Your choice. We ship the iPhone 17 Pro to you, or wire the €1,200 cash equivalent — whichever you prefer. Decision is yours after the draw.
faq.a5: Libo pays out the full prize with no tax withheld. Your personal tax obligations depend on your country of residence — please check local rules.
faq.q6: What happens when my access window ends?
faq.a6: Your account simply reverts to whatever tier you were on before — Free, Pro, or Elite. Nothing is auto-charged. Any unconverted points stay in your balance permanently. Want more access? Buy another pack, no commitment.
faq.q7: Where can I watch the live draw?
faq.a7: Libo's Instagram (@liboworld) and TikTok (@libo.world). The full draw is archived for replay. You don't need to watch live — winners are contacted directly via the email tied to their account within 24 hours.
faq.q8: I'm already a Pro / Elite subscriber — what happens?
faq.a8: You keep your existing subscription, untouched. The pack credits its points to your balance and extends your access window — no double-charge, no plan downgrade. Buy as many packs as you want; points and access days stack.
faq.q9: Can I buy multiple packs? Do points and access stack?
faq.a9: Yes — every pack adds to whatever's already on your account. Buy Entry today and Gold next week and you've got 3,100 points plus 37 days of full-app access (7 + 30). We use the email you give us to find your existing account or create a new one.
faq.q10: Do I need a Libo account before buying?
faq.a10: No. We auto-create one with the email you provide at checkout and send you a magic link to sign in. Existing Libo users (anyone who's signed up before) get the points and access credited to their existing account — same email = same account.

cashChallengeFunnel.howItWorksSub: Cohort-based — all participants run the 30-day clock together. Miss a day with no freeze tokens, you're out. Finish, you get paid.
cashChallengeFunnel.step1Body: Pick your tier inside the app. Each cycle is capped at 50, first-come-first-served — the clock starts on the fixed date OR when 50 join, whichever comes first.
cashChallengeFunnel.step2Body: 100/200/300 reps per day by tier. Push-ups auto-count via camera. Squats and pull-ups use a tap counter. Splittable across sessions.
cashChallengeFunnel.step3Body: Every day, no gaps. Pro/Elite get 1/3 freeze tokens for missed days. Free tier is strict — one miss and you're ejected.
cashChallengeFunnel.step4Body: Finish all 30 active days and the cash hits your linked account within 48 hours of cycle end. €15, €50, or €250 — your choice.

faq.a1: No. Every single person who completes 30 active days gets paid. It's a guaranteed payout for consistency, not a draw.
faq.q2: What counts as a completed day?
faq.a2: Hitting your tier's daily rep count for that day, logged in the Libo app. Reps can be split across multiple sessions. Push-ups auto-count via camera; squats and pull-ups use a tap counter.
faq.q3: What happens if I miss a day?
faq.a3: Free tier: one miss and you're out for that cycle. Pro: 1 freeze token covers 1 missed day, end date pushes by +1. Elite: up to 3 freeze tokens.
faq.a4: Within 14 days of completing your 30th active day, after identity and anti-fraud checks pass. Payout is to the linked account on file — Stripe / SEPA / Wise depending on region. Payout providers require winners to be 18+; if you're 16–17, you can use a parent-linked verified payment account, otherwise the reward is converted to equivalent in-app credit (extra tickets or a Premium month) within 14 days.
faq.q5: Can I enter multiple tiers at once?
faq.a5: No — one active enrollment at a time. You can enroll in the next cycle's tier once your current one ends.
faq.a6: The reward is a real cost to Libo. Capping spots makes the payout budgetable and creates a real cohort feel — everyone runs the clock together.
faq.q7: Do I need a Libo subscription?
faq.a7: Free Starter tier — no. Pro Pool needs Pro (€9/mo). Elite Pool needs Elite (€19/mo). Subscribe in the app when you join your tier.
faq.a8: Start with Starter (100 reps/day) — that's about 5 minutes of work, splittable across the day. The rep count is achievable; the discipline is the challenge.
